description: This is a Python script (sercomm-crypto.py) that generates a header and cryptographic key data for a given input file, incorporating specific header fields and MD5 hashing. It appears to be part of a custom or specific cryptographic processing pipeline, potentially used for preparing files with custom headers and keys.

methods.name: create_header(key, version, iv, random, size)

methods.name: create_output(args)
